LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Option.FAParallelUpdate.De: Moves facial animation updates from the main thread to the parallel object rendering preparation phase.
LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Option.FADeLinq.Desc: LINQ expressions are a data query method in C#, but they are unfriendly to Unity's Garbage Collection system, generating significant GC overhead at runtime. This optimization rewrites all LINQ expressions into GC-friendly traditional data queries.
LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Option.FADeLinqBurst.Desc: Accelerates facial animation processing using Burst. Requires "Remove LINQ" to be enabled.
LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Option.FAAnimCache.Desc: Caches the list of facial animations to avoid frequent reconstruction.
LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Option.FAPawnSpawn.Desc: Caches some information used during pawn generation to reduce stuttering when pawns spawn.
LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Option.FATextureCache.Desc: Optimizes the loading of facial textures by the Facial Animation mod, making it use the texture caching system provided by this mod, reducing stuttering during pawn generation.
LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Option.HARDeLinq.Desc: LINQ expressions are a data query method in C#, but they are unfriendly to Unity's Garbage Collection system, generating significant GC overhead at runtime. This optimization rewrites all LINQ expressions into GC-friendly traditional data queries.
LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Option.HARTextureCache.Des: Optimizes texture loading for the Humanoid Alien Races mod by using the texture caching system provided by this mod. This provides significant performance improvements for races with dynamic body parts.
LanguageData.YaOpt.Setting.Option.VEFMemoryLeakFix.De: Vanilla Expanded Framework has two caches that are never cleared, causing pawn spawning in the game to remain in memory even after loading a save, until the game is exited. This optimization clears these two caches when loading a save and clears the caches once a day in-game.
